name: Titian
findings: Uses raisin black 2.1x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 901 paintings here).
Uses dark walnut 2.0x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 901 paintings here).
Uses smoky black 2.0x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 901 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, pale peach turns up as a small accent in 40% of the paintings that hold it, 3.5x the archive's rate (from 901 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, slate navy turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 6.9x the archive's rate (from 901 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, deep rose red turns up as the shadow in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 2.4x the archive's rate (from 901 paintings here).
Pairs cool grey with grey more than chance would predict (3 of 901 paintings here).
Pairs broccoli brown with buffy brown more than chance would predict (4 of 901 paintings here).
